'''Black_wraith Profit, who's profitting now''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 12 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Profit Black_wraith LS 2003 Profitwh 5081.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is an upgraded verson of the deck I posted awhile back, what do you think of the changes?

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Release Han when ever it is economically viable, win the podrace, play I did it, spread, drain and damage.

My interrupts are not at total random. they are, for the most part, "Battle interups," as they almost all add battle destinies(gift adds 2, out of nowhere 1, slight weap. 1, i know 2, and protector 2), the exceptions are some one, wookie roar, the signal, and organized attack, which release han, pull or retrive chewie, pull effects, or pull x-wings, respectively. i agree with the addition of shields, but i do not have any. thanks for reminding me of the bacta tank, the thought totally sliped my mind.  i also like starting prem han because he is the only one you can retreive all 10 force.

by the way i forgot to signify some of my virtuals so take a look. Vanden (V) pulls leia and jackes her deffense up to 7, so thats why he's present
